blocks.content: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: When selected, the oven heats up to 275 o C.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: Once the oven reaches temperature (>265  o C), add 1 litre of water in an appropriate covered glass container.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: Select the green tick to start. The oven will run for 10 minutes cycling around a cavity temperature of 275 o C, 50% microwave power and 100% convection fan.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: During the test carefully check the appliance casing, joints, and door seal for signs of steam or water escaping from the cavity. If necessary, rectify any leaks and repeat the test.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: On completion of the test, specify the result by selecting 'Pass' or 'Fail'.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: Safely remove the container of water from the cavity.

blocks.content: Note: Opening the door during the test will stop the test. Reselect the test to run again.

blocks.section: Soak test: checking the cavity integrity
blocks.content: This test is only generally recommended for workshop activities.

blocks.section: Recommissioning test: checking the appliance operation
blocks.content: Recommissioning test: checking the appliance operation

blocks.section: Recommissioning test: checking the appliance operation
blocks.content: The recommission tests are performed following the completion of a planned maintenance visit, or repair to ensure that the appliance is working correctly before handing back to the customer.

blocks.section: Recommissioning test: checking the appliance operation
blocks.content: Some of the tests have a countdown timer, where failing to carry out a test within the time limit will cause a test failure and the recommission test will have to be restarted.

blocks.section: Recommissioning test: checking the appliance operation
blocks.content: If the 'recommission test' tab is greyed out, the oven is above 200°C and will not allow to the test to commence until the oven is cooled down.
